entries.message: Docs - Consolidate watchlist sync simplification, retire Emby/Jellyfin clients
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Removed Emby and Jellyfin watchlist clients (library-specific playlists/favorites cannot hold unwatched titles and are operationally unsound)
Simplified Personal Rating and Watchlist sync to unified single toggle in Settings
Updated all docs to reflect Plex-only watchlist support with safe first-run union, durable retry queues, and provider-owned state tracking
Refactored watchlist sync settings UI into single cohesive panel with status, queue preview, manual sync, and provider recovery actions
Updated CLAUDE.md with managed Windows workspace Git permission requirements
Updated test suite for watchlist provider adapters and backup/restore scenarios
Aligned Settings, onboarding, and help-content modules with new unified sync flow
